title: Fresh-chat regression matrix for the Aug 25 good envelope and Aug 26 policy stack
forensic_invariants: Primary instruction bytes outrank retrospective incident-report reconstructions of the active contract.
Tool-call volume is an execution metric, not proof that the conclusion or mutation claim is correct.
A claimed external mutation requires an execution-surface call in the same turn or independent corroboration.
Model identity and thinking effort are recorded so instruction changes are not inferred from a model-mode confound.

definitions.fresh_chat: The measured turn begins at the first visible user message in the conversation.
definitions.turn_window: From that first user message up to, but not including, the next visible user message.
definitions.tool_call: An assistant message in the turn whose recipient is neither null nor all.
definitions.snapshot_selection: Among raw exports with the same conversation_id, select greatest mapping size, then update_time, then basename.

cases.purpose: First clean strong-good fresh-chat boundary after the no-bootstrap rewrite.
Long direct project execution from a minimal fresh prompt.
Negative control proving direct MCP execution already existed before the 15:18 saved-memory update, without claiming the conclusion was correct.
Post-15:18 direct MCP execution, retained as a continuity/control row rather than the origin of execution.
Exact-mode negative control: the later stack can still sustain long execution under GPT-5.6 Thinking/extended.
